segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the March 18 go-live is still good and make sure the seat count on the order form matches what finance is expecting.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: March 18 still works. We’re starting with 64 seats, not 70. Six of those managers won’t need access until Q3, so we don’t want them on the first invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 64 active seats at launch, with the option to add six later at the same $82 per seat monthly rate. I’ll update that in the CRM and send the revised order form today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. One thing, though. On the kickoff yesterday, your onboarding lead said the data import was set up for 90 days of history. We had agreed to 18 months during contracting, because our renewal reports need the older tickets.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Ah, yeah, I’m sorry. That should have been in the handoff notes to the implementation team. I’ll get that corrected after this call and make sure they plan for the 18-month import.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks. We just need to know if that changes the timeline, because our current tool renews April 1 and I’m trying not to pay for overlap.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. Based on the file size you sent, I don’t think it changes March 18, but I’ll confirm with services by end of day. If there’s any risk, I’ll flag it before you sign the revised order.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Also, billing needs the first invoice dated March 1, net 30, with the PO number on it. PO is 48177.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect, PO 48177, March 1 invoice date, net 30. The annual total with 64 seats and the standard support package comes to $62,976 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that matches my sheet. Send it over and I’ll route for signature this afternoon.
